PipedriveAPITokenCredential.title: PipedriveAPITokenCredential
PipedriveAPITokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Find your API token under Settings -> Personal preferences -> API, and your company domain in your Pipedrive URL (the subdomain before .pipedrive.com).

PipedriveOAuthCredential.description:
OAuth 2.0 credential for Pipedrive (authorization_code flow).

Tokens are obtained via the OAuth flow, not entered manually. Pipedrive
access tokens expire after 60 minutes and are auto-refreshed via the
refresh token. The token response also returns an ``api_domain`` — the
company-specific base URL all API requests must target — which we persist.

Register an OAuth app in the Pipedrive Developer Hub:
https://developers.pipedrive.com

api_domain.description: Company-specific base URL returned with the token (e.g. https://acme.pipedrive.com).
api_domain.title: API Domain

PipedriveOAuthCredential.title: PipedriveOAuthCredential
PipedriveOAuthCredential.x-oauth-custom-client-help: Optionally bring your own Pipedrive OAuth app. Register one in the Pipedrive Developer Hub (https://developers.pipedrive.com), set its redirect URI to NoClick's Pipedrive callback, and paste its client ID and secret here. Leave blank to use NoClick's shared Pipedrive app.
